blockId.description: the block the pool belongs to, copied from the card

poolKey.description: the pool key, copied from the card exactly

stance.description: a spine carries the pool key; a face is one thing a person could notice

source.description: the face source this unit speaks through, from the card faceSources

pair.description: the pair kind where the card names one for this pool, else an empty string

text.description: the unit itself: no em dash, no exclamation mark, no digit, no semicolon, no contraction, no first person, no will or shall

units.description: one entry per pool on the card, in the card page order
